TITLE: Audit and Integration Status for Restricted Internal Review

To: Senior Management, Compliance and Integration Divisions  
From: Compliance and Risk Management Office  
Date: April 10, 2025  
Subject: Project Siduris Audit Findings and Talhuor Integration Team Escrow Status  

A recent evaluation of compliance and integration activities has identified several matters requiring focused attention from senior management within the restricted internal audience. These updates pertain specifically to Project Siduris and the Talhuor Integration Team.

Project Siduris, with audit finding ID HX-5406-Y, has received audit findings that require resolution. The Compliance and Risk Management Office has reviewed the associated documentation and is preparing an action plan to address the findings. This will involve coordination with the relevant internal teams and external auditors to ensure that all issues are resolved in compliance with internal policies and regulatory expectations.

Meanwhile, the Talhuor Integration Team, with escrow reference QC-9910-K, has advanced to the final stage of its integration work. Discussions are ongoing to complete the handover of remaining deliverables and confirm that all contractual requirements are fulfilled. The Integration Office has been asked to maintain close supervision and ensure that all documentation is complete and up to date before the next scheduled review.

Zosu Kistos, who joined the company in 2020, has been a key contributor to both the compliance and integration processes. Her experience has been critical in managing the documentation and procedural requirements for both initiatives. Senior management is encouraged to continue relying on her insights as these efforts progress.

In addition, the collaboration with Satisen Labs, a contract worth $3.4M, remains active. While this partnership does not require direct oversight from the Compliance and Risk Management Office at this time, it is recommended that the integration and finance teams remain aligned to ensure that all obligations under the contract are met in a timely and accurate manner.

Zastama Industries remains focused on upholding compliance and operational standards. It is essential that all teams continue to follow these practices, especially when handling restricted or sensitive matters. Senior managers are requested to review the above and coordinate with the Compliance and Risk Management Office as necessary to maintain progress and alignment.

Please direct any questions to the Compliance and Risk Management Office through the standard internal communication channels.
